🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. VXX falling (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) BELOW TREND and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%) confirm risk appetite, with XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) as a second confirmation; watch mixed credit signals via HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.35%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.01% | 1M: +2.21%) CORRECTION.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear decreasing: VXX falling (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Speculative/momentum flows lifting cyclicals and growth: MTUM (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND. Counter: credit stress slightly elevated per HYG/LQD signal.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength rising (1W: +1.25% | 1M: +2.06%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND while Yield Curve steepening (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +3.29%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND; TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +4.90%) shows bonds still participating.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech-led risk: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%) with semis strength. Energy lagging: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%). Style: Growth/momentum leadership confirmed.

5. US vs Global?
US strong: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%); EM pockets outperforming: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.42% | 1M: +10.73%). China remains weak: FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -7.52%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation elevated: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +8.53%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +8.60%) showing healthy risk-taking; crypto weak: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -18.11%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Copper mixed: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.21% | 1M: +3.27%). Gold RECOVERY (GLD 1W: +0.21% | 1M: -5.92%) while precious metals broadly under pressure (SLV BELOW TREND 1W: -2.15% | 1M: -11.05%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy under pressure: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) and oil ETFS USO BELOW TREND (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -24.90%), BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -25.39%). Natural gas recovering: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -1.34%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%), XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%). DIVERGENCE: several CORRECTION signals in XRT, LQD and XLV (1W negative vs 1M positive) — minor divergence, watch for follow-through.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor growth/momentum exposure: XLK (1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%) ABOVE TREND and MTUM (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +15.83%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to energy-linked ETFs XLE (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) BELOW TREND; bonds neutral (TLT ABOVE TREND 1W: +0.90% | 1M: +4.90%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology/semis (XLK ABOVE TREND 1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%; SOXX ABOVE TREND 1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%). BEARISH: Energy (XLE BELOW TREND 1W: -5.86% | 1M: -12.27%) and oil exposures (USO BELOW TREND 1W: -10.84% | 1M: -24.90%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Natural gas (UNG RECOVERY 1W: +5.20% | 1M: -1.34%). BEARISH: Crude/oil baskets (BNO BELOW TREND 1W: -10.69% | 1M: -25.39%) and broad oil proxies.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~22.8 (complacency if sustained below ~20); HYG/LQD watch around current divergence (HYG 1W: +0.09% | 1M: +1.35% ABOVE TREND vs LQD 1W: -0.01% | 1M: +2.21% CORRECTION); XLK/XLF momentum gap (Tech vs Financials level 3.57, watch for reversion).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, confirmed by VXX falling (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -17.33%) BELOW TREND and SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +2.04%). Technology/semis and momentum ETFs are showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND 1W: +4.49% | 1M: +10.51%; SOXX ABOVE TREND 1W: +9.00% | 1M: +28.79%). Key risk: mixed credit signal (HYG vs LQD) and pockets of 1W/1M CORRECTIONs in select sectors that warrant monitoring.
